title: ‘Sunday Night Football’: How to Watch the Indianapolis Colts vs. Kansas City Chiefs Game Live Online Free
summary: Watch the Colts take on the Chiefs on Sunday, Sept. 20 — keep an eye out for a possible Taylor Swift sighting at the game too.
contentText:

For NFL week two, the league heads to Kansas City for Sunday Night Football . For the game, two AFC powerhouses battle each other to see which team is going to dominate the conference for the 2026-2027 season . Plus, there might be one or two celebrity sightings during the game too.

How to Watch ‘Sunday Night Football’ Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Sept. 20

- Network: NBC

- Matchup: Indianapolis Colts vs. Kansas City Chiefs

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Peacock

Watch on DirecTV

When Does ‘Sunday Night Football’ Start ?

Sunday Night Football takes place on Sunday (Sept. 20) with the Indianapolis Colts taking on the Kansas City Chiefs at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri. Kick off is at 8:20 p.m. ET/5:20 p.m. PT.

What TV Network Features ‘Sunday Night Football’?

In 2026, Sunday Night Football broadcasts on TV on NBC. Meanwhile, the NFL game is available to livestream on Peacock.

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances ‘Sunday Night Football’?

The NFL is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance during the game. Artists who have been known to appear at games in the past, include Kansas City Chiefs fans Taylor Swift, Heidi Gardner, Paul Rudd, Eric Stonestreet and others.

Where to Watch ‘Sunday Night Football’ Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch Sunday Night Football , if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, such as Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , also offer free trials, so you can watch the game for free.
